mapper.sql: id, cert_type, cert_number, owner_college_id, created_by, submitter_user_id, reviewer_user_id, event_id, session_id, group_id, cert_title, award_level, issu_date, resource_key, status, remark, created_at, updated_at
mapper.select: SELECT c.id, c.cert_type, c.cert_number, col.college_name, creator.username as creator_name, submitter.username as submitter_name, reviewer.username as reviewer_name, ce.event_name, cs.session_name, sg.group_name, c.cert_title, c.award_level, c.issu_date, c.resource_key, c.status, c.remark, c.created_at, c.updated_at, -- 学生获得者信息 u_student.real_name as student_real_name, u_student.student_id, -- 指导教师信息 u_teacher.real_name as teacher_real_name, u_teacher.teacher_id FROM certificate c -- 关联学院信息 LEFT JOIN college col ON c.owner_college_id = col.id -- 关联创建人、提交人、审核人 LEFT JOIN sys_user creator ON c.created_by = creator.id LEFT JOIN sys_user submitter ON c.submitter_user_id = submitter.id LEFT JOIN sys_user reviewer ON c.reviewer_user_id = reviewer.id -- 关联赛事、赛届、科目组别 LEFT JOIN competition_event ce ON c.event_id = ce.id LEFT JOIN competition_session cs ON c.session_id = cs.id LEFT JOIN subject_group sg ON c.group_id = sg.id -- 关联证书获得者（学生） LEFT JOIN certificate_recipient cr ON c.id = cr.certificate_id LEFT JOIN sys_user u_student ON cr.recipient_user_id = u_student.id -- 关联指导教师 LEFT JOIN certificate_instructor ci ON c.id = ci.certificate_id LEFT JOIN sys_user u_teacher ON ci.instructor_user_id = u_teacher.id WHERE c.submitter_user_id = #{userId} OR c.create_by = #{userId} OR cr.recipient_user_id = #{userId} OR ci.instructor_user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY c.created_at DESC, c.id

SELECT c.id, c.cert_type, c.cert_number, col.college_name, creator.username as creator_name, submitter.username as submitter_name, reviewer.username as reviewer_name, ce.event_name, cs.session_name, sg.group_name, c.cert_title, c.award_level, c.issu_date, c.resource_key, c.status, c.remark, c.created_at, c.updated_at, u_student.real_name as student_real_name, u_student.student_id, u_teacher.real_name as teacher_real_name, u_teacher.teacher_id FROM certificate c LEFT JOIN college col ON c.owner_college_id = col.id LEFT JOIN sys_user creator ON c.created_by = creator.id LEFT JOIN sys_user submitter ON c.submitter_user_id = submitter.id LEFT JOIN sys_user reviewer ON c.reviewer_user_id = reviewer.id LEFT JOIN competition_event ce ON c.event_id = ce.id LEFT JOIN competition_session cs ON c.session_id = cs.id LEFT JOIN subject_group sg ON c.group_id = sg.id LEFT JOIN certificate_recipient cr ON c.id = cr.certificate_id LEFT JOIN sys_user u_student ON cr.recipient_user_id = u_student.id LEFT JOIN certificate_instructor ci ON c.id = ci.certificate_id LEFT JOIN sys_user u_teacher ON ci.instructor_user_id = u_teacher.id WHERE c.id = #{certId}
